Name: Run Code Execution Agent
Author: cbf81976-f755-4f3f-83fd-a1b7e124ac7f
Description: Launches an agile Google ADK Agent that utilizes Gemini's native, built-in Python execution tool. Unlike standard sandbox environments which require configuring a dedicated cloud container resource, this action executes Python  code natively inside Google's backend API lifecycle. The agent can dynamically write and run Python scripts to handle formatting, log analysis, or mathematical operations, returning consolidated step-by-step reasoning, the generated  script, and the output console log as a single, clean Markdown report on the Case Wall.

Parameters.DefaultValue: Calculate the first 10 elements of the fibonacci sequence
